facts.scope_summary: Technical conversion of Alcon's SAP ECC 6.0 EHP6 environment to SAP S/4HANA 2025 on-premise using a no-change principle, including platform migration from Oracle 19c on AIX to HANA 2.0 on Red Hat Linux 9.6. Scope includes mandatory simplification remediation, custom code and analytics remediation, multiple mock/load verification cycles, testing/validation, cutover, training support, governance, change communications, and 1 month of hypercare.
in_scope: Conversion from SAP ECC 6.0 Ehp6 to SAP S/4HANA 2025 On-Premise Upgrade
Oracle 19c on AIX to HANA 2.0 on Red Hat Linux 9.6 platform
Mandatory SAP Simplification items (133 No) remediation through No-Change Principle
SUM/DMO Downtime Optimized Conversion (DoC) with CustOnTemp
Update of security framework, add-ons & bolt-on
SAP BW, Datasphere, and SAC artifact assessment/remediation/validation/hypercare
out_of_scope: Only mandatory simplifications are included under the no-change principle
assumptions: No-Change Principle applies to the conversion
Mandatory simplification items only; no elective changes
Maximum production downtime target is ≤48 hours
10 conversion cycles are planned, including 8 mocks
